summary: Absolute moisture lockdown. A maximum-strength roll-on that physically halts sweat production for up to 48 hours.
description: Extreme atmospheric defense. Designed for hyperhidrosis or intense physical exertion, this formula utilizes a concentrated aluminum compound to form a temporary, harmless plug within the sweat duct.
technical_overview: Offered at $20.0 for 50ml, this KoColor ANTIPERSPIRANT is expertly formulated with Aluminum Zirconium Tetrachlorohydrex Gly (20%) and Cyclopentasiloxane. It delivers a high-fidelity Opaque White color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages glandular duct plugging.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply exclusively at night to completely dry underarms before bed.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Nighttime application is critical; the sweat glands are least active during sleep, allowing the aluminum salts to properly form the barrier block.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Cyclopentasiloxane provides a rapidly evaporating base, ensuring the product dries instantly and prevents clothing transfer.
